portedFilesDerivation: From the banners, not from the previous record: every file under src/ whose banner names an upstream path — 398 (396 'vendor port' banners: 395 .ts + network/shapes/Trade/history.tsx; plus the `//` banners network/index.ts and network/comps.ts, the latter's phantom specifier still absent upstream). For each of the 397 real paths, `git diff --quiet 04cb25f8 8fb6ea58 -- <path>` in a blob-filtered clone of the mirror (every path present at both commits); src/abi/World.json (recorded in src/abi/README.md) is unchanged too.
bannerRule: Every ported banner names the new pin. The 371 ported files whose upstream path is byte-identical at 04cb25f8 and 8fb6ea58 (370 checked with `git diff --quiet`, plus network/comps.ts, still absent upstream) change only their banner line; the 27 that changed upstream are forward-ported below, and network/shapes/Auction/pricing.ts is newly ported. G5.d requires the pin on every vendor banner.

client.app/cache/auction/functions.ts: TAKEN (8fb6ea58). calcPrice counts elapsed time from getPriceStart(auction, time) instead of auction.time.start. Same change in network/explorer/auctions/pricing.ts, the calc the daemon's `auctions` query serves.
client.app/cache/auction/base.ts: TAKEN (8fb6ea58). get() re-reads the pause window on every read (one component read; an admin can set it at any time).
client.app/cache/trade/history.ts: TAKEN (42130a33). Type-only: imports `Timestamps` (the type the Trade index now re-exports) instead of the phantom `Timestamp`.

contracts/libraries.LibAuction.sol: calcBuy passes getPriceStart as the GDA start: StartTs pushed forward by the part of the pause window that has passed (elapsed(t) = t - startTs - clamp(t - pauseStart, 0, pauseEnd - pauseStart)). verifyRequirements (the not-started refusal) still reads StartTs.
contracts/libraries.LibAuctionRegistry.sol: setPause (0,0 clears; one window per auction), getPause, packPause / unpackPause (uint64 start << 64 | uint64 end), getStartTs; remove() also removes TimePause.

state-affecting.systems: _AuctionRegistrySystem gains setPause(itemIndex, pauseStart, pauseEnd), admin only: the auction must exist; a non-zero window must end after it starts, must have ended (pauseEnd <= block.timestamp) and must start at or after the auction's StartTs; (0, 0) clears it. create() returns LibAuctionRegistry.create's id. The admin set the window on auctions 10 and 11 at 2026-11-02 01:28:57Z (the lab's chain evidence; 2026-10-23T15:49:50Z → 2026-11-02T01:28:41Z).
state-affecting.runtime tripwire: Before the mapping, every daemon boot logged `Unknown component: 0x9ff2cdae…fdd1fc0` once per windowed auction (two per boot) and status.degraded carried `unknownComponentIds:2` for the life of the process (the Mac daemon, 1.0.5, 2026-11-02T03:03:31Z boot). Mapping the component retires both; the live 10-minute check is the lab's gate.
